capabilities: Reveal dot-prefixed hidden files and folders in the file explorer
Rescan for hidden files created after startup via a command
Keep chosen file or folder names hidden through an ignored-names setting
Enable Obsidian's unsupported-file visibility setting while active
extras: Warns that it reveals sensitive or high-volume paths (.obsidian, .git, .env) and depends on undocumented Obsidian internals, so it may break on Obsidian updates; desktop-only, no telemetry or network requests.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer hides dot-prefixed files and folders, so users cannot see or open paths like .git, .env, or .trash from within the app.
summary: Desktop plugin that reveals every dot-prefixed hidden file and folder in the vault's file explorer, at any depth.
